pages.headline: &3An Unfamiliar Horizon
pages.text:
The hum of active leyline monoliths echoes across the valley floor. Your compass spins aimlessly, throwing old coordinates into chaos.

Look for stone formations emitting high-frequency &9Soul Particles&r.

pages.headline: &bInterfacing the Terminal
pages.text:
Insert the ancient memory core directly into the primary monolith pedestal receptacle to bypass security protocols.

Doing this will prompt a defensive system countermeasure sequence.
